description: (needs account token) Lists file paths on a site you can update. site is the address, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app. A site token for that site works, including before the site is claimed, the same way an update with that token does. Without a token, claim the site first. Read-only. Does not charge.

site.description: The address of the site, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.
